overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic San Marino Elite 2-Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness experience right at home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for spaces like basements or master baths, providing a sanctuary for relaxation and improved circulation. With six strategically placed Ultra Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, it ensures efficient, soothing heat, while the Canadian Hemlock wood construction adds a touch of elegance. Enhance your sessions with the interior chromotherapy lighting and built-in Bluetooth speakers, creating a personalized, spa-like atmosphere.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Dynamic Saunas are constructed of environmentally-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood planks. Our saunas feature energy PureTech™ Ultra-Low EMF Heating Technology that help relax and rejuvenate the body. Dynamic Saunas can be installed on carpet or any indoor location including basements, master baths, walk in closets or can also be added to a fitness room.
